nodes.label: Manuscripts
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Books written by hand, usually on palm leaf or birch bark. They dealt with religious beliefs, lives of kings, medicine, science, epics, poems and plays. Many were in Sanskrit, Prakrit and Tamil.

nodes.label: Archaeology
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: The study of material remains of the past including buildings, paintings, sculpture, tools, weapons, pots, ornaments and coins. Archaeologists excavate sites to reconstruct historical narratives.

nodes.label: BC/AD Dating System
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Chronological system counting years from the birth of Christ. BC means Before Christ, AD means Anno Domini. CE (Common Era) and BCE (Before Common Era) are also used as secular alternatives.

nodes.label: Indian Subcontinent
nodes.subject: history
nodes.detail: Includes present-day India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Bhutan and Sri Lanka. Bounded by seas, hills and mountains. Called a subcontinent because it is very large though smaller than a continent.
